CustomField.formula: IF( AND( Include_In_Annualized_Software_Spend__c == True, OR( SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Account__r.Deployment_Method__c = "Cloud", SBQQ__Quote__r.SBQQ__Account__r.Deployment_Method__c = "Hybrid" ) ), IF( ISBLANK(SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c) || SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c = 1, SBQQ__NetTotal__c / SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c * 12, SBQQ__NetTotal__c / (SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c * SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c) * 12 ), 0 )
CustomField.label: Calculated Software Spend
